title: Tracking High-Frequency Trading Activity in China and Its Effects on Market Quality
abstract: arXiv:2610.33400v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a new order-level proxy for high-frequency trading (HFT) activity based on precise order placement and study its effects on market quality. With quotes updating multiple times per second, millisecond-level order-book access makes high-frequency traders more likely to submit active exact-match orders, defined as limit orders priced exactly at the prevailing best opposite-side quote. Using Shenzhen Stock Exchange data, we validate the proxy: active exact-match orders respond faster to quote updates, cancel more rapidly, concentrate when depth imbalance is favorable and spreads are narrow, and predict mid-quote returns from 100 milliseconds through ten minutes. A difference-in-differences design exploiting cross-channel variation in order dissemination latency at the market open shows that lower latency increases active exact-match shares. This variation yields plausibly causal evidence that latency-induced HFT raises short-horiz

translated_title: 追踪中国高频交易活动及其对市场质量的影响
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种基于精确下单的新型订单级高频交易（HFT）活动代理指标，并研究其对市场质量的影响。由于报价每秒更新多次，毫秒级的订单簿访问使高频交易者更倾向于提交主动精确匹配订单——即价格恰好等于当时对手方最优报价的限价订单。基于深圳证券交易所的数据，我们验证了该代理指标的有效性：主动精确匹配订单对报价更新的反应更快、撤销更迅速，在订单簿深度失衡有利且买卖价差较窄时集中出现，并能预测100毫秒至十分钟内的中间价收益。我们利用市场开盘时订单传播延迟的跨通道差异构建双重差分设计，结果表明更低的延迟会增加主动精确匹配订单的占比。这一变化提供了较为可信的因果证据，表明延迟降低所引发的高频交易提升了短周期……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出以主动精确匹配订单作为高频交易活动的新型订单级代理指标，并利用深交所开盘时订单传播延迟的跨通道差异提供因果证据，研究高频交易对市场质量的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel order-level proxy for HFT activity based on active exact-match orders and exploits cross-channel order dissemination latency variation at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange open to provide causal evidence on HFT's effects on market quality.
